标题: 报价后未回复｜温和跟进
英文即时消息: Hi [Name], just checking in. Did you get a chance to look at the quote? Happy to answer any questions.
中文对照: 你好 [Name]，跟进一下，报价单看过了吗？有任何问题随时问我。

英文即时消息: Hi [Name]! Your lashes should have arrived by now. How do your clients like them? 😊
中文对照: 你好 [Name]！睫毛应该已经到了，客人用着感觉怎么样？😊

英文即时消息: New in: our [New product]! Super soft and lightweight. Want me to add a tray to your next order?
中文对照: 上新啦：[New product]！超柔软轻盈。下次订单要不要加一盒试试？

英文即时消息: Black Friday sale: [Discount]% off all lashes until [End date]. Message me to place your order early!
中文对照: 黑五促销：全场睫毛 [Discount]% 折扣，截止 [End date]。早下单早发货！

英文即时消息: If you're happy with the order, would you mind leaving a short review on [Platform]? It really helps our small team 🙏
中文对照: 如果对订单满意，方便在 [Platform] 留个简短好评吗？对我们小团队帮助很大 🙏

英文即时消息: I'm sorry your parcel is late. I've contacted [Carrier] and will update you within 24 hours.
中文对照: 抱歉包裹晚到了。我已联系 [Carrier]，24 小时内给您回复进展。

英文即时消息: So sorry to hear that! Could you send a photo of the damaged items and the box? I'll arrange a replacement right away.
中文对照: 非常抱歉！麻烦拍一下破损的商品和外箱发给我，我马上安排补发。

英文即时消息: You're right, we sent [Wrong curl] curl instead of [Correct curl]. We can send the correct trays free with your next order, or refund $[Refund amount]. Which do you prefer?
中文对照: 您说得对，我们把 [Correct curl] 卷发成了 [Wrong curl] 卷。可以下次订单免费补发正确的，或者退款 $[Refund amount]，您选哪种？

英文即时消息: A little shedding in the first washes is normal. Please wash with cool water, don't brush it wet, and use a wide-tooth comb. If it continues, send me a short video.
中文对照: 前几次清洗少量掉发是正常的。请用凉水洗，湿的时候别梳，用宽齿梳。如果一直掉，拍个短视频给我。

英文即时消息: I understand. Please return the unused items to [Return address] within 14 days and we'll refund $[Refund amount] once they arrive.
中文对照: 明白。请在 14 天内把未使用的商品寄回 [Return address]，我们收到后退款 $[Refund amount]。
使用备注: 发送前核实退款金额和地址
